{{Dialogue|Calrissian|You two have got your birth certificates with you, don't you?|Solo|Are you kidding? Mine's at my sky house back on Bespin.|Organa|And my birth certificate was destroyed when the Empire blew up Alderaan.|attr=Lando Calrissian, Han Solo, and Leia Organa hit a snag in the wedding plans|src=<ref name="Queen">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref>}}
A '''birth certificate''' was a document that served as a form of identification. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] lost her birth certificate in the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Queen" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[5 ABY/Legends|Five]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later,<ref name="Readers">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'' in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> Organa traveled with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Hologram Fun World]] to be [[Marriage/Legends|married]], where they met up with their friend [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], the world's [[Baron Administrator/Legends|baron administrator]]. After seeing to various preparations, Calrissian told the couple they would need to go to the administration building to have their birth certificates scanned by the [[Fun World Document Droids]]. Solo stated that he had left his at his [[Han Solo's sky house|sky house]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], and Organa explained the fate of her certificate. Calrissian stated that he would arrange for new birth certificates at the [[Document Bureau]], but could not do so that [[Standard day/Legends|night]] due to its early closure for [[Fun World Founder's Day]]. The administrator promised to arrange new documents the following morning.<ref name="Queen" />

==Behind the scenes==
Birth certificates were first mentioned in ''[[Queen of the Empire]]'', a [[1993]] junior novel by [[Paul Davids]] and [[Hollace Davids]].<ref name="Queen" />
